skills.label: Admin controls
skills.desc: Organization settings for Claude Science on Team and Enterprise plans (Featured connectors and skills, custom connectors and skills, access to Claude Science work previously saved on the computer, the network allowlist, package mirror, SSH hosts, Modal, scientific model endpoints, and memory) and wh… Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/admin-controls

skills.label: Use Claude Science on a corporate network
skills.desc: How to run Claude Science behind an outbound proxy, a TLS-inspecting proxy, an internal package mirror, and an egress firewall, with the settings your network team needs for each. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/corporate-networks

skills.label: Enable Claude Science
skills.desc: Claude Science is a desktop app for scientific research. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/enable-claude-science

skills.label: How Claude Science works with your data
skills.desc: What Claude Science keeps on your computers, what it sends to Anthropic and how long Anthropic keeps it, who can access it, Anthropic's no-training and ownership commitments, and the controls available to your organization. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/how-claude-science-works-with-your-data

skills.label: Manage Claude Science on devices
skills.desc: Claude Science is a desktop application that stores member content locally. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/manage-on-devices

skills.label: Monitor Claude Science usage
skills.desc: Claude Science uses the same seat as the rest of claude.ai. Track its adoption and usage in Analytics and through the Admin API. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/monitor-usage

skills.label: Network requirements
skills.desc: The domains Claude Science connects to, grouped for a proxy or firewall allowlist: the app's connections to Anthropic, the analysis sandbox's package and research domains, the domains a package mirror adds and removes, and the built-in list of domains it always blocks. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/network-requirements

skills.label: Cloud storage
skills.desc: Connect Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob Storage so Claude can read data and write results in place, with your permission. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/cloud-storage

skills.label: Compute providers
skills.desc: Claude Science can run jobs on an external cloud provider you control, and connect to model servers that serve scientific models over HTTP. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/compute-providers

skills.label: Connectors and skills
skills.desc: Connectors give Claude access to external data sources during an analysis. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/connectors-and-skills

skills.label: Custom connectors
skills.desc: Add any Model Context Protocol (MCP) server as a Remote (HTTPS web server) or Local command (program on your computer). Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/custom-connectors

skills.label: Literature access
skills.desc: Claude retrieves open-access full text without credentials; add publisher keys or a library proxy to reach paywalled text you're entitled to. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/literature-access

skills.label: Remote compute clusters
skills.desc: Connect a machine you can reach over SSH (a lab workstation or an HPC login node) so Claude can run jobs on it. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/remote-compute-clusters

skills.label: Run on a remote Linux server
skills.desc: Install Claude Science on a cloud VM or lab server and use it from your own browser through an SSH tunnel. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/run-on-remote-linux-server

skills.label: Tools and environments
skills.desc: Claude writes and runs Python, R, and shell commands. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/tools-and-environments

skills.label: Example gallery
skills.desc: Browse nine example prompts from nine fields of science, each the start of a complete analysis in Claude Science. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/example-gallery

skills.label: Genetic drift in a bottle: Buri's 107 fruit-fly populations
skills.desc: Simulate 107 bottles of 16 fruit flies drifting by chance alone and compare them with Peter Buri's real bottles (1956). Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/example-gallery/bio-drift

skills.label: A titration curve from the full equilibrium: which indicator finds the equivalence point?
skills.desc: Solve the full equilibrium for 25.0 mL of 0.100 M acetic acid as 0.100 M NaOH is added, without the usual shortcuts. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/example-gallery/chem-titration

skills.label: A first Kaplan–Meier curve: the 1963 leukemia trial of 6-MP
skills.desc: Compare 6-MP against placebo with Kaplan–Meier curves from 42 remission times typed into the prompt. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/example-gallery/clin-km

skills.label: PageRank on a web of 11 pages: why 1 good link beats 6 weak ones
skills.desc: Follow a random surfer on Wikipedia's 11-page example until the numbers settle, and reproduce all 11 published values to 0.1 point. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/example-gallery/cs-pagerank-tiny

skills.label: A first finite-element model: a clamped steel ruler bends and vibrates
skills.desc: Split a 300 mm steel ruler clamped at one end into 4 beam elements and check its bending under 1 N and its first 3 vibration modes against beam theory. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/example-gallery/eng-beam

skills.label: A first X-ray diffraction pattern: why silicon shows 6 peaks and salt 9
skills.desc: Simulate the X-ray powder patterns of silicon and table salt and label every peak with Bragg's law. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/example-gallery/mat-xrd

skills.label: The Ulam spiral: are the primes' diagonal streaks real?
skills.desc: Compare the share of primes per diagonal on Ulam's 1963 spiral of 1 to 40,401 against as many random odd numbers. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/example-gallery/math-ulam

skills.label: The double slit, one electron at a time
skills.desc: Rebuild the picture of Tonomura's 1989 experiment with an ideal double slit: each electron lands as 1 random dot, yet fringes 10.7 µm apart build up. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/example-gallery/phys-doubleslit

skills.label: Schelling's segregation model: ask for 30% same-color neighbors, end up with 75%
skills.desc: Ask for 30% same-color neighbors, end up with about 75%: the textbook computer version of Thomas Schelling's 1971 idea. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/example-gallery/soc-schelling-small

skills.label: Artifacts in Claude Science
skills.desc: Artifacts in Claude Science are files Claude saves into a project, such as figures, datasets, and reports. Open, version, trace, and delete them. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/artifacts

skills.label: Auto mode
skills.desc: Auto mode lets Claude Science run code and call connectors without stopping to ask about every step. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/auto-mode

skills.label: Comments
skills.desc: Comments in Claude Science pin a note to a specific part of an artifact, such as selected text or a point on a figure, and send the note to Claude. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/comments

skills.label: Core concepts
skills.desc: A project groups related sessions and the artifacts they produce. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/core-concepts

skills.label: Get started
skills.desc: Install Claude Science on macOS, Windows, or Linux, sign in with your Claude account, and run your first analysis. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/get-started

skills.label: Claude Science in its own window on macOS
skills.desc: Keep working when Claude Science switches to its own window on a Mac: open, quit, and update it, and turn macOS permissions back on. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/mac-app-window

skills.label: Use Claude Science on more than one computer
skills.desc: What to expect when you sign in on another computer, or under another sign-in on the same computer. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/multiple-computers

skills.label: Claude Science
skills.desc: Anthropic's AI workbench for rigorous science. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/overview

skills.label: The reviewer
skills.desc: A built-in verification step that independently re-reads Claude's recent responses, the approved plan, saved artifacts, and the execution record, then checks whether its claims match what ran. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/the-reviewer

skills.label: Update Claude Science
skills.desc: Install the latest version of Claude Science on Mac, Windows, or Linux, and get past an Update required message or an update that fails. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/update-claude-science

skills.label: Claude Science changelog
skills.desc: Release notes for Claude Science, including new features, improvements, and bug fixes by version. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/changelog

skills.label: Command line settings
skills.desc: Reference for the claude-science command: its subcommands, the serve flags, the single-use login link, and the environment variables you can set. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/command-line-settings

skills.label: Configuration file reference
skills.desc: Claude Science's config.toml file: where it lives, how it interacts with Settings, and its network, web search, and upload keys. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/configuration-file-reference

skills.label: Glossary
skills.desc: One-sentence definitions for the terms you meet in Claude Science, from artifact to workspace. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/glossary

skills.label: Legal and compliance
skills.desc: Legal agreements, compliance certifications, and security information for Claude Science. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/legal-and-compliance

skills.label: Safeguards
skills.desc: What happens when a model's safeguards flag a message, how to switch models automatically, and how to choose a use case under the Life Sciences Verification Program (beta). Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/safeguards

skills.label: Troubleshoot Claude Science
skills.desc: Fix errors you see while using Claude Science: being signed out, capacity retries, Agent Failed, environment setup, connectors, dictation, and updates. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-science/troubleshooting
